verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory lists a Slack integration that turns messages into tasks and comments, plus a GitHub integration that syncs pull request status to tasks. It also lists a broad catalog of other connectors, including Jira, GitLab, Figma, and Notion. Google is referenced only through broader 'Google Workspace' connector listings that appear to come from third-party integration platforms, not a clearly native Drive integration. Missing for 10: an explicit native Google Drive integration, confirmation that the Slack and GitHub integrations are first-party rather than partner-built, and independent or hands-on corroboration of setup depth.
